locked_rules: Step 24 is the only autonomous production scheduler for the weekly football/market lifecycle.
Legacy Step 8, 9, 11, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 23 cron writers must be disabled after Step 24 is merged.
Manual production worker runs may exist only behind the same weekly-production-orchestration concurrency group.
A downstream stage cannot execute after an upstream hard failure.
Missing data remains missing and cannot be converted to zero or neutral evidence.
Sportsbook data remains downstream and cannot mutate football projections, True Value, or comparison winners.
Frozen forecasts and settlement revisions remain immutable under their existing contracts.
Calibration cannot tune and score the same observation and cannot auto-promote a challenger.
No automatic wagering, staking, or bet execution is permitted.
Repository writes from the orchestrator are persisted in one atomic commit after all non-writing stages complete.
